# 南山祖師禮讚文

**ID:** X1504
**Volume:** X74
**Category:** 律部類
**Original Category:** 禮懺部
**Byline:** 宋 智圓述
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1504

## Contributors
- 智圓 (A001282)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Northern-Sòng *lǐzàn wén* 禮讚文 (worship-and-eulogy liturgy) for the death-anniversary of **Nánshān Dàoxuān** 南山道宣 (596–667), the *Chéngzhào Dàshī* 澄照大師, founder of the Sìfēnlǜ Nánshān 四分律南山 (Four-Part Vinaya) school. Composed by **Gūshān Zhìyuán** 孤山智圓 ([智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93), 976–1022), the leader of the *Shānwài* 山外 wing of Sòng Tiāntái. The author signature reads *Gūshān shāmén shì Zhìyuán shù* 孤山沙門釋　智圓　述. The work opens the trio of Sòng *Nánshān zǔshī lǐzàn wén* preserved as X1504–1506 (= [KR6k0207](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0207), [KR6k0208](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0208), [KR6k0209](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0209)); these three were brought together as a unit and prefaced (元符三年 = 1100) by **Yúháng Yuánzhào** 餘杭元照 ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7), 1048–1116), the *Língzhī Dàzhì lǜshī* 靈芝大智律師.

**Abstract**

Zhìyuán's *Nánshān zǔshī lǐzàn wén* is the **earliest Sòng *zànyí* for the founder of the Nánshān Vinaya school**, written between his entry into mature literary activity (ca. 1000) and his death in **1022**, in response to a request from a *lǜshī* at *Dōushuàiyuàn* in Mt Zéwú. The text follows the standard *zànyí* structure: an opening *yīxīn fèngqǐng* 一心奉請 (onemind invocation) of the master, prostrations, *zàncí* 讚詞 (eulogy stanzas) walking through the fourfold scheme of *Dàoxuān*'s biographical episodes (*Rìyán jīngshè* 日嚴精舍, transmission of the *vinaya*, the heavenly responses, the deathbed *fùfǎ* 付法), and closing offerings. The prose preface (by Zhìyuán himself) contains the formula *Nánshān jiàozhǔ Chéngzhào Dàshī lìshì lìyán dàchǎn píní zhī xué* 南山教主澄照大師立事立言大闡毗尼之學 — "the master of the Nánshān, the Great Master Chéngzhào, who *both established the deeds and established the words, greatly explicating the study of vinaya*." Composition is bracketed by Zhìyuán's mature career at *Gūshān* on West Lake; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are set 1000–1022. For the parallel later *zànyí* see [KR6k0208](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0208) (by Rényuè) and [KR6k0209](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0209) (by Yǔnkǎn).
